t: GU10 lampholder comes with a 4-way FastFix box to ensure quick and easy installation. Ideal for upgrading low voltage downlights to mains voltage GU10 lamps. Quick and easy wiring connection thanks to push-lever fast-fix terminal block. Loop-in, loop-out terminals for quick installation of multiple downlights. No tools required, simply pop open the terminal box cover and press down the lever terminals to wire. Class 2 construction with spare terminal for earth termination if required. Fitted with 13cm long fly lead.
